name: Compton Bell Farms
tagline: Discover endless fun at Compton Bell Farms
description: Compton Bell Farms is a family-run farm in Buford, GA. It grows Strawberries and Corn, with seasonal availability through spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
